disposition:transitions:C16:03.candidate_contract_note: Current whole-edge source conformance. Strict next-version selection and own-tag incomplete recovery use one typed observation. Full tag/source identity is supplied at outer per-target planning and all four rechecks; malformed/unreadable/foreign unfinished observations error rather than becoming absent. Current retained-artifact and required pre-tag gates are additional explicit prerequisites. Each target output is independently set from its own ELIGIBLE; optional dispatch filter applies only to matching target. Required pretag runs only for eligible new tags. The separate eligibility-errors job reports failures without becoming a dependency of the four publisher jobs. Parsing/observation/pretag/artifact failure sets only that target false and appends FAILED. Exact-source original-run recovery uses fresh observations; siblings with valid eligibility continue. Intentional change: R01 replaces public-means-complete with tag+package+receipt completion and source ownership. R03 pretag becomes required; R02 requires retained exact build artifacts. These are explicit candidate guards, not falsely called byte-identical old logic. No live Q03/installed/runtime/platform completion claim.
